verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform inherently pre-generates recurring payroll runs on a company's pay schedule (gusto-docs-62) and exposes webhooks so external apps can react to recurring events like payroll.paid (gusto-docs-16/49), and the new agent CLI ships bundled 'payroll-prep' and 'cash-forecasting' skills that could be invoked on a schedule by an external cron/agent (gusto-contest-61-5). However, there is no documented first-party scheduler/cron primitive that lets an AI-native user define arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows inside Gusto itself — recurrence is baked into payroll cadence, not a general automation feature. Missing for 10: a native recurring-job/workflow scheduler API or CLI subcommand (e.g., 'gusto schedule'), and independent evidence of agents actually orchestrating recurring workflows via webhooks/CLI.
